name: Makewood Plantation
description: In 1388 17th Street, TX, Makewood Plantation grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on an independent apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring and summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
